It seems like the pgbouncer connection pool has been exhausted, which is causing worker throughput to drop to 0. Restarting pgbouncer in the prod namespace might resolve this issue temporarily. However, as per your instruction, I will not proceed with this action without your approval.

Let's first explore other possible causes and solutions.

I will start by checking the status of the pgbouncer service and reviewing its logs.
